agentInterface.flow: preview-first, always: run a preview-* command (baw contract-call preview — a simulation that broadcasts nothing), show the user the decoded summary, and only on their explicit go-ahead run execute <requestId>. Never execute a stale (expired) preview.
agentInterface.helper: node agent/agentproof.js <command> (run from the repo root)

description: On-chain work receipts between Agent ID holders on BNB Chain. An issuer attests that someone delivered work; the recipient confirms on-chain; only confirmed receipts build reputation tied to a non-transferable Agent ID. Receipts are attestations by the issuer — AgentProof does not verify the underlying work. No tokens, no payments, no returns are promised or involved.
name: AgentProof
safety: Value is always 0 — the AgentProof contract has no payable functions and moves no funds.
Preview first, always: a baw preview is a simulation only; execute is a separate step that requires the user's explicit go-ahead for that specific preview.
A correct preview shows empty allowanceChanges and authorityChanges and no risks — anything else means stop.
No approvals are ever requested; there is nothing to approve.
Never collect seed phrases, private keys, pairing codes or passwords; pairing happens only in the user's Binance App.
AgentProof never resolves Agent ID names to other people's wallets.
